name: Al'ar normal and Greater Seals retain one strongest mana-regeneration effect (#4883)
contract: Seal of Al'ar ranks 803649/803729/807704/807770/808012 and Greater 808060 share family 30 flag 65536
and the same mana-regeneration aura 85. Their active descriptions give the same buff to one ally or
the party. Rank five and Greater both restore 33 mana every five seconds. They must replace each other
without doubling that effect, following the native strongest ordinary/Greater class-buff contract.
A level-16 caster's first rank restores only 10 mana every five seconds and must not displace or add
to a Greater Seal from another caster. Normal learning, grouped casts, aura ownership and the native
mana-regeneration field exercise the rule. The first rank and highest ordinary rank are normally
available at levels 16 and 56; Greater is available at 58. No seal aura is supplied as a fixture.

steps.label: One Seal adds 33 mana every five seconds to native regeneration
Greater replaces the equal ordinary Seal
Greater cannot double the same regeneration effect
The native cast rejects a weaker buff as SPELL_FAILED_AURA_BOUNCED
Another caster's weaker Seal cannot add to or replace Greater
An equal ordinary Seal replaces Greater in the reverse direction
